title: Dynamic-experiment immutable content-object graph
description: Declares one compact acyclic graph over immutable local and cross-commit content objects. Runtime validation must require disjoint unique object IDs, make the topological_order an exact permutation of every local and imported object ID, require every ordered root and edge endpoint to exist, require each edge source to precede its target, and recompute graph_digest over the canonical graph projection with graph_digest omitted. Object payloads are never embedded: local objects resolve only through local_descriptors and historical objects only through verified imported_handles.

local_descriptors.description: Exact locations for objects owned by this immutable graph root; ref, not path, carries identity authority.

imported_handles.description: Path-free references to objects owned by earlier verified commits; source paths are intentionally not repeated here.

ordered_roots.description: Ordered semantic entrypoints into the graph. Each ID must resolve exactly once in the union of local and imported objects.

edges.description: Typed prerequisite edges. For every edge, source_object_id is the prerequisite and must precede target_object_id in topological_order.

topological_order.description: An exact, duplicate-free ordering of all local and imported object IDs; omissions and undeclared IDs are invalid.

edge.description: A closed typed dependency from one declared object to another. edge_kind names why the target depends on the source; self-edges, unknown endpoints, duplicate endpoint/kind triples, and order violations are runtime errors.
